links.comparator_used: General prompt with no readability instruction (prompt A); results were also reported relative to ASRS brochures
links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated retina patient education materials
links.effect: Prompt B (sixth-grade target) significantly improved readability across all LLMs relative to ASRS brochures (mean ASRS grade level 14.17), but outputs still exceeded the sixth-grade level. The abstract gives no direct prompt A vs prompt B numbers.
links.tradeoff: Outputs still missed the sixth-grade target. The abstract reports no significant differences in misinformation or actionability, and the authors say expert oversight remains essential.
links.quote: Prompt B significantly improved readability across all large language models relative to ASRS but still exceeded the sixth-grade readability level.
